scope: Agent-triggered Safe Input TUI credential enrollment
tui_checks: Real POSIX PTY login and token entry, all fields masked
Full CLI/isolated-worker/TTY flow using disposable synthetic secret-tool stub
No sentinel values in terminal transcript or tool stdout/stderr, including reflected store output
Tool stdin never used as enrollment fallback
Parent terminal echo disabled before spawn; pending input flushed and terminal restored
MCP and CLI metadata-only result contracts and invalid argument rejection

native_store_checks.linux: Pipe-based enrollment covered using synthetic stub; no live Secret Service session used
native_store_checks.macos: Native add/update/release/buffer-wipe paths covered with fakes; not run on macOS

limits: Not a security boundary against unrestricted processes under the same OS identity
Requires local controlling terminal and curses; no browser/stdin fallback
Login records enroll data only; no automatic website authentication
